summary.text: Allison Knab is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 12 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Democratic primary.
She is a former executive director of the Great Bay Stewards nonprofit.

paragraphs.text: Allison Knab was born in Virginia, lives in Stratham, New Hampshire, and earned a degree in biology from the University of Virginia.
Her career experience includes work as the executive director of the Great Bay Stewards nonprofit, and she has served as vice chair of the Stratham Select Board.
Ballotpedia lists general-election wins for Knab in Rockingham 12 in 2022 and 2024.
She was assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
